decoder.name: Key-press CNN + en char 6-gram beam (Fidetype)
decoder.weights_licence: not released (trained on CC BY 4.0 data)
training_data: Tatoeba en (CC BY 2.0 FR) for the char LM

policy.name: trust gate + CRC
policy.description: commit threshold by conformal risk control, alpha 0.05

shuffled.basis: aggregate null audit (n=200): wrong-commit real 0.575 vs frame-shuffled 1.000

zeros.basis: aggregate null audit: wrong-commit real 0.575 vs zeros input 1.000

guarantee.scope: marginal wrong-commit rate over test sentences; exchangeable
guarantee.calibration_split: cal (held-out half of the fit items)

conformance.checked: local composed streams (cache streams/calib/test00_ctc.npz); provenance fails only on decoder.weights_sha256 and stream.id

notes: Composed sentences from isolated key presses: not natural typing.

safe_wpm.calibration: cal (held-out half of the fit items)
safe_wpm.timing: track rate model: len(truth) * 60 / 75.7576 chars/min (composed sentences, no natural typing time)

correction_rule.name: rewrite
correction_rule.formula: 2 s + 0.7895 s/char * len(truth) per wrong commit

safe_wpm.no_bci_note: gaze typing of every sentence at 20 chars/min (the eWPM reference)

basis.shuffled: aggregate null audit (n=200): wrong-commit real 0.575 vs frame-shuffled 1.000
basis.zeros: aggregate null audit: wrong-commit real 0.575 vs zeros input 1.000

safe_wpm.basis: aggregate approximation: committed-correct words = share_words_system x test words; wrong-commit penalty at the mean test sentence length; no per-trial data, so no CI
